cause_quote: The new Access page error map added `limit_reached: "This claw has reached its limit for people or devices. Remove one to add another."` although the protocol at that commit also returned `limit_reached` for invitation limits such as `an invite lasts at most ${days} days`.
user_saw: When an invitation hit a count or duration limit, the Remote access page told the owner to remove people or devices.
summary: Changed the limit_reached message to a generic limit notice that points the owner to the error details.
reasoning: Blame puts the removed line on e29577b7d7df, which created people-error.ts; git grep at that commit shows packages/openclaw-id-protocol/src/authority/apply.ts already emitting limit_reached for invite count and lifetime limits, so the misleading guidance shipped with the page.
